notes.text: Behind the scenes: the app now tells the Dreaming server which version it is, so the team dashboard can show which versions people use. Nothing changes on your screen.
The bottom bar (Home, Journal, Insights, Calendar, Profile) sits a little higher above the bottom edge of the screen.
Journal map: the 'Newest dreams' button is gone (pinch, or double-tap, to zoom in and out), giving the sign a bit more room. 'Pinch to zoom' is now just text, without a box.

Journal: Map / Squares / Rows and List / Stories / Milky Way are now round glowing buttons with their names underneath, like Story / Details / Sleep on a dream. 'Pinch to zoom' sits next to the List button so it no longer covers your dreams, and the map reaches down to the bottom bar. On a dream, 'Add an AI image of this dream' is now 'Visualise as image'.

Journal map: 'Newest dreams' and 'Pinch to zoom' sit lower, at the very bottom of the map, so the map keeps more room. The List / Stories / Milky Way switch floats just above the bottom bar again, with a small gap.

The bottom bar (Home, Journal, Insights, Calendar, Profile) is a bit bigger again, the Journal title, magnifying glass and '+ Dream' are a little bigger, and the map's 'Newest dreams' / 'Whole sign' button is smaller.
Journal map is bigger: the sign now fills the whole map, with less empty sky around it, so your dreams spread out more and are easier to tap.

Journal: more room for the map. The closing line is gone, the map fills the screen, the Journal title row sits at the very top, the filter bar is slimmer, and the List / Stories / Milky Way switch sits right on a shorter tab bar that reaches the bottom edge. A night with several dreams is now a bigger circle with one coloured arc per dream (zoom in to see their titles). On a dream's page, a new 'Remembered more? Add to this dream' button opens it ready to add more.
Journal map: the dream circles are much smaller, so a whole month of dreams still fits neatly on a sign. Pinch in to see dates and titles bigger.

Journal: the scorpion emblem is purple again, the 'General' filter is gone, and choosing a filter no longer pops up an extra line or moves the map. The top is packed tighter: filters right under the title, the Map / Squares / Rows switch attached below them, and the date row right under it.

Journal map, new look: your scorpion picture appears once, big and glowing near the top-left of the Scorpio map, and every dream is a small circle with its day number and its date underneath. Pinch in to see the dream titles. Other signs show their big sign symbol until we add their pictures.

Journal map: Scorpio dreams now use your scorpion drawing, glowing in the dream's colour, with the day and weekday written under it (pinch in for the month and the title). The heading row is a bit tighter so '12 Thursday · November' always fits in full.
Journal map: today's date is always written in full, like '12 Thursday · November', on every phone size.

Journal: switching between Map, Squares and Rows always lets you come back to Map. If the Map ever can't be drawn on your phone, the Journal shows your dreams as rows with a short note saying why (please send us a screenshot of it), and Map stays chosen so you can tap it again.
Journal map: the heading row now runs edge to edge: the sign, today's date as a number with the weekday and month (like '12 Thursday · November'), and a small '5 dreams' you can tap.
Journal: the magnifying glass is a plain icon again, and it and '+ Dream' are a little shorter, leaving more room for your dreams.

Journal map: the heading is just the sign's circle and 'Today, Thu, Nov 12'; the dreams count is now a button that lists that sign's dreams. The Map / Squares / Rows switch is centred under the filters and smaller, leaving more room for the map.

Journal map: no more box. The sky is open and the Milky Way flows across the page and fades away, like the Milky Way view. The heading is one line now: 'Today, Thu, Nov 12 · Scorpio season · 5 dreams'.
Journal: the 'Zodiac' look is now called 'Map' (Map / Squares / Rows).
Journal: the magnifying glass now sits next to '+ Dream' at the same size, and the filter squares get the whole row.

Journal zodiac map: the top now says 'Today is' with the real date, then the sign season (older signs show their months). Dreams from the same night now share one creature with a small number on it; tap it to see all that night's dreams.

Zodiac map opens further out, so you see the whole sign with every dream on it, and each creature always shows its day and weekday (pinch in for the month and the dream's title). The search is just a magnifying glass now, and the filter squares sit together in one rounded shape.

Example dreams are now clearly marked. If the app's built-in example dreams are in your journal, Home says so (they come with the app and are not yours or anyone else's) with a one-tap 'Remove the examples', and each one carries an 'Example' tag. Your dreams are only ever kept on your own phone.
Fixed: the Journal could not open when the Squares look was chosen. If a look ever fails to draw, the Journal now opens in Rows instead of showing an error.

Zodiac map: each sign season is now a sky map with the Milky Way behind it, and every dream is drawn as that sign's creature (a scorpion for Scorpio, a crab for Cancer...) with its date, weekday, month and title inside. The map opens close on your newest dreams; pinch with two fingers to zoom, or tap 'Whole sign'. Journal: search is now a small magnifying glass, and the row is filled with bigger filter squares. Home: 'Show less' after 'Load more'. Settings: 'Remove example dreams' if example dreams were added.

Journal: a new Zodiac look (first in the Zodiac / Squares / Rows switch). Your dreams are grouped by sign season, like Scorpio 23 Oct to 21 Nov, and each group takes the shape of its real constellation, with every dream a glowing star you can tap. Each star shows which sign the Moon was in that night, and the dream page now says 'Moon in … · Sun in …'.
Home: recent dreams are a bit smaller, the 5 newest show first and 'Load more dreams' adds 5 more. Each date tile now shows the weekday too, like 'WED 11 NOV'.

Journal squares are smaller: three across, the first 6 dreams of each month, and 'Show all' opens the rest (tap 'Show less' to fold them again). The day label is now one small line at the top, like '9 MON'.

Dream types and Journal filters are now small squares in one big square. On a dream page, tap a square to pick General, Lucid, Nightmare or Prophetic. In the Journal, the small square next to search opens all the filters as squares. The Journal list can show each month as a square of dream squares, each with its day and weekday (switch Squares / Rows to compare). Dates now say the weekday too, e.g. '3 days ago · Monday'. The picture buttons are now 'Visualise as image' and 'Visualise as video'. Also fixed: Journal filters didn't respond to taps.

Team review fixes. Tap any symbol to read what it means, from our dream books (not only your own dreams). A small moon-cycle card on Home and Insights. Bigger recent dreams on Home. Profile: Personalise Dreaming with all the welcome questions, and the 'kept on this iPhone' note. Journal: List, Stories (with exact dates) and Milky Way. Calendar: the Grid has the day card too, and the circle has a See more button. Dream page: a new dream-type chip and round tabs.
New layout: the tab bar is now Home, Journal, Insights, Calendar, Profile (Profile moved to the far right).

Home now follows the PDF: your 3 newest dreams with their name, date and symbols (a gold date tile on the left), and a Load more button that adds 3 more each time. The voice button and the 'Your day' card are gone from Home (write about your day in the Calendar tab).
Insights: Your dream sky is now at the top of the page, with Recurring symbols right below it.

New layout, as the team decided: Home is simple again (your 3 newest dreams in a list). The dream circle is now the Calendar tab, with a day card under it and a Grid option. Sky moved to Insights as 'Your dream sky', and symbol meanings now open in full with Read more. Journal views: List, Calendar, Gallery, Moons, Stories and the new Milky Way.
New layout Journal: the switcher is back to List, Calendar and Gallery. The six new views (Sky, Spiral, Year, Moons, Stories, River) are now under 'Test 6 new journal views' while we choose.

New layout Journal: six new ways to see your dreams, next to List, Calendar and Gallery. Sky (dreams as stars, shared symbols form constellations), Spiral (today in the centre, older dreams spiralling out), Year (12 months like a zodiac, then the month wheel), Moons (each night with its real moon phase), Stories (swipe big dream pictures) and River (a ribbon coloured by how each dream felt).

New layout: the dreams on Home are now a dream wheel. The month is a circle like a zodiac, labelled 1st, 2nd, 3rd…; days with dreams light up with their picture, and the middle shows the chosen day's dream.

A second layout to compare: Settings → App layout → New layout. Home · Journal · Insights · Profile · Calendar, with recurring symbols and their meanings, dream types (general, lucid, nightmare, prophetic), a picture gallery, reflection questions, a personalisation survey, and a day journal that connects what happened in your day with the dreams that follow.
Clearer allowance: Settings and your plan now show what's left this month (e.g. '50 left of 60 video credits') and explain that 1 video credit = 1 second of Standard video (HD uses 2).
Dream films: a long dream (250+ words) can become a 20, 30 or 45 second film, told in 2 or 3 scenes in order and joined into one video, with 'scene 2 of 3 ready' progress while it's made.

Choose your dream video: length from 5 to 15 seconds (longer dreams unlock longer videos), Standard or HD quality, and whether it starts from your AI photo. Plus now gives 60 video credits a month; you see the cost and about how long it takes before you create.

AI dream videos (Dreaming Plus): turn a dream into a short, lifelike video with sound, starting from its AI photo. Watch it full screen with sound and save it; it also plays on Home and on the dream page, with a play mark in the Journal.
AI dream images are now lifelike photos instead of paintings.
Dreaming Plus and AI dream images: free and Plus plans with monthly allowances, a paywall, a subscriptions page, redeem codes, and AI paintings of your dreams (also at the top of Analyze).

The full Dreaming experience: personal onboarding, a two-step recorder with Story/Details/Symbols/Lucidity, a save celebration, a Lucidity tab with 10 unlockable techniques, articles and sounds, Progress with levels and analysis, Settings with reminders, passcode lock and export.
Dream interpretation (beta) for testers: switch it on in Profile → Labs, then tap 'What does it mean?' on a dream.
Dreaming becomes a dream journal: record by voice or typing, a picture for every dream, Journal with calendar, Insights, Profile with morning reminder.
App renamed to Dreaming.
Home screen cleared: just the background picture, ready to start building.
New starry night-sky picture as the Home screen background.
First version: the app installs on your Home Screen, opens full-screen, works offline, and updates itself.
